sanskrit: ya ekavṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
english: You who are a one-bull [potion], you are of releasing essence.

sanskrit: yo dvivṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
english: You who are a two-bull [potion], you are of releasing essence.

sanskrit: yas trivṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
english: You who are a three-bull [potion], you are of releasing essence.

sanskrit: yaś caturvṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
english: You who are a four-bull [potion], you are of releasing essence.

sanskrit: yaḥ pañcavṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
english: You who are a five-bull [potion], you are of releasing essence.

sanskrit: yaḥ ṣaḍvṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
english: You who are a six-bull [potion], you are of releasing essence.

sanskrit: yaḥ saptavṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
english: You who are a seven-bull [potion], you are of releasing essence.

sanskrit: yo 'ṣṭavṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
english: You who are an eight-bull [potion], you are of releasing essence.

sanskrit: yo navavṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
english: You who are a nine-bull [potion], you are of releasing essence.

sanskrit: yo daśavṛṣo 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
english: You who are a ten-bull [potion], you are of releasing essence.

sanskrit: yo 'podako 'si sṛjāraso 'si ||
english: You who are without water [waterless], you are of releasing essence.

sanskrit: ekā ca me daśa ca- -apavaktāra oṣadhe | ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu tvā madhulā karat ||
english: One and ten are mine — O herb that repels adversaries! Truth-born, truth-protecting, may the honey-maker make you sweet.

sanskrit: dve ca me viṃśatiś ca apavaktāra oṣadhe | ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu tvā madhulā karat ||
english: Two and twenty are mine — O herb that repels adversaries! Truth-born, truth-protecting, may the honey-maker make you sweet.

sanskrit: tisraś ca me triṃśac ca apavaktāra oṣadhe | ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu tvā madhulā karat ||
english: Three and thirty are mine — O herb that repels adversaries! Truth-born, truth-protecting, may the honey-maker make you sweet.

sanskrit: catasraś ca me catvāriṃśac ca apavaktāra oṣadhe | ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu tvā madhulā karat ||
english: Four and forty are mine — O herb that repels adversaries! Truth-born, truth-protecting, may the honey-maker make you sweet.

sanskrit: pañca ca me pañcāśac ca apavaktāra oṣadhe | ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu tvā madhulā karat ||
english: Five and fifty are mine — O herb that repels adversaries! Truth-born, truth-protecting, may the honey-maker make you sweet.

sanskrit: ṣaṭ ca me ṣaṣṭiś ca apavaktāra oṣadhe | ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu tvā madhulā karat ||
english: Six and sixty are mine — O herb that repels adversaries! Truth-born, truth-protecting, may the honey-maker make you sweet.

sanskrit: sapta ca me saptatiś ca apavaktāra oṣadhe | ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu tvā madhulā karat ||
english: Seven and seventy are mine — O herb that repels adversaries! Truth-born, truth-protecting, may the honey-maker make you sweet.

sanskrit: aṣṭa ca me 'śītiś ca apavaktāra oṣadhe | ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu tvā madhulā karat ||
english: Eight and eighty are mine — O herb that repels adversaries! Truth-born, truth-protecting, may the honey-maker make you sweet.

sanskrit: nava ca me navatiś ca apavaktāra oṣadhe | ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu tvā madhulā karat ||
english: Nine and ninety are mine — O herb that repels adversaries! Truth-born, truth-protecting, may the honey-maker make you sweet.

sanskrit: daśa ca me śataṃ ca apavaktāra oṣadhe | ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu tvā madhulā karat ||
english: Ten and a hundred are mine — O herb that repels adversaries! Truth-born, truth-protecting, may the honey-maker make you sweet.

sanskrit: śataṃ ca me sahasraṃ ca- -apavaktāra oṣadhe | ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu tvā madhulā karat ||
english: A hundred and a thousand are mine — O herb that repels adversaries! Truth-born, truth-protecting, may the honey-maker make you sweet.

sanskrit: ā paśyasi prati paśyasi parā paśyasi paśyasi | dyām antarikṣam ād bhūmiṃ tat sarvaṃ devi paśyasi ||
english: You see hither, you see back, you see away, you see — heaven, the atmosphere, and earth: all that, O goddess, you behold.

sanskrit: tisro divas tisraḥ pṛthivīḥ ṣaṭ cemaḥ pradiśo mahīḥ | tayāhaṃ sarvān yātūn paśyāni devy oṣadhe ||
english: The three heavens, the three earths, and these six great quarters — by you may I behold all sorcerers, O divine herb.

sanskrit: suparṇasya divyasya tasya hāsi kanīnikā | sā bhūmim ā rurohitha vahyaṃ śrāntā vadhūr iva ||
english: You are the pupil of that divine Suparṇa [the celestial eagle]; you have climbed up to earth like a weary bride carried in a vehicle.

sanskrit: tāṃ me sahasrākṣo devo dakṣiṇe hasta ā dadhat | tayāhaṃ sarvaṃ paśyāmi yad bhūtaṃ yac ca bhāvyam ||
english: Her has the thousand-eyed god placed in my right hand; by her I see all that has come to be and all that shall be.

sanskrit: yathā śvā caturakṣo yathāśvaḥ śyāvo 'rvatām | yathāgnir viśvataḥ pratyaṅṅ evā tvam asy oṣadhe ||
english: As the four-eyed dog, as the dark horse among steeds, as fire facing in every direction — so are you, O herb.

sanskrit: kaśyapasya cakṣur asi śunyāś caturakṣyāḥ | vīdhre sūryam iva sarpantaṃ mā piśācaṃ tiras karaḥ ||
english: You are the eye of Kaśyapa, the four-eyed one of Śuni; do not conceal from me the piśāca moving like the sun through the clear sky.

sanskrit: darśaya mā yātudhānān darśaya yātudhānyaḥ | āpaspṛta iva tiṣṭhantaṃ darśaya mā kimīdinam ||
english: Show me the yātudhānas, show me the yātudhānīs; show me the kimīdin standing as though just bathed.

sanskrit: ud agrabhaṃ paripāṇaṃ yātudhānāt kimīdinaḥ | tenāhaṃ sarvaṃ paśyāny uta śūdram utāryam ||
english: I have seized the all-protecting [herb] from the yātudhāna and the kimīdin; by it I see everything — both the Śūdra and the Ārya.

sanskrit: yathā sūryaś candramāś ca viśvā bhūtā vipaśyataḥ | evā vi paśya tān tvam aghāyur mopa gād iha ||
english: As the sun and moon behold all beings — so do you behold them; may the evil-living one not approach here.

sanskrit: yo antarikṣeṇa patati bhūmiṃ yaś copasarpati | divaṃ yo manyate nāthaṃ taṃ piśācaṃ dṛśe kuru ||
english: He who flies through the atmosphere, he who crawls along the earth, he who regards heaven as his refuge — make that piśāca visible.

sanskrit: āviṣ kṛṇuṣva rūpāṇi mātmānam apa gūhathāḥ | adhā sahasracakṣo tvaṃ prati paśyāsy āyataḥ ||
english: Reveal your forms; do not conceal yourself — for you, O thousand-eyed one, see [me] as I come toward you.
